title: Electron
resourceType: Cross-platform Desktop Application Runtime / Web-to-Desktop Shell
purpose: 讓既有 JavaScript、HTML、CSS 前端技術直接用來建立 macOS、Windows、Linux 桌面應用。Electron 把 Chromium renderer 與 Node.js-powered main process 組合在同一個 runtime，由 main process 管理視窗、生命週期與 native desktop APIs，renderer 負責 Web UI，並透過 preload、contextBridge 與 IPC 建立受控的權限橋接。
recommendation: 適合已有 Web 技術棧、想快速建立跨平台桌面 App，或需要把 React／HTML UI 接到檔案系統、系統選單、通知、tray、視窗與其他 native desktop capability 的專案。
notes: Official repository and docs confirmed. Electron is built on Chromium and Node.js and ships cross-platform binaries for macOS, Windows and Linux. Its architecture separates privileged main process from renderer processes; preload/contextBridge/IPC should be used as a narrow capability boundary. Security guidance recommends disabling Node integration for remote content, keeping context isolation and sandboxing enabled, validating IPC senders and not exposing privileged Electron APIs to untrusted content. MIT licensed.
